buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. Qualified Resident Engineer/Technician well experienced in Computers repair and mainte nance should be available on three working days in a week (Monday-Friday) between 9.00 AM to 5.30 PM. The designated three days in the week shall be intimated by the BUYER. De puted resident engineer should be having adequate knowledge regarding troubleshooting o f computer CPU., computer monitors, and related peripherals.

2. No external storage device shall be plugged to the Computers by BIDDER or his rep without the permission of the User. The purpose for plugging the device shall be stated bef ore seeking permission. 3. Resident Engineer/Technician shall not access any unauthorized sites using the Compu ters that are connected to the Internet. Necessity of accessibility to any such site for the re pair and maintenance in such Computers will be discussed with the IT Officer of BUYER and upon grant of permission, details of site will be accessed, will be mentioned in the Log Regi ster for records. 4. Foreclosure of Contract. In the event BUYER decides not to continue with the contract due to various reasons viz., technological up gradation, replacement of computers, SELLER’ s failure in carrying of work to the satisfaction of BUYER etc., BUYER reserves the right to fo reclose the contract with pro-rata payment to the contractor for the work carried out till the foreclosure date. In this regard BUYER’s decision is final and binding on the part of the SELL ER. Minimum one-month advance notice shall be issued by BUYER to SELLER regarding fore closure of Contract. In certain cases, the notice period can be reduced, in the event of failur e to undertake CAMC as per agreed timelines. 5. The bidder can inspect the Desktop PCs, Printers, and UPS with prior intimation to the offi ce. 6.The replacement of printers toner & drum and UPS battery are included in the CAMC. 7. The deails and location of PCs, printers and UPS is attached in"Buyer added Specfic SLA. 8. The bidder should read the terms and condition properly 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA File Attachment Click here to view the file.

8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Controller , CQA(BEML) Bengaluru payable at Bengaluru . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
